reason: I already use the free one and it does everything I need. I'd probably stop opening any app in two weeks anyway, so paying for pet species and a room feels like paying for a thing I'll abandon.
objection: I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks, like every other one, so $6.99 is wasted. None of the Plus stuff helps me actually start tasks, it's just cute extras.
would_change_my_mind: If I'm still using the free app daily after a month and love my pet, I might buy for the new species. Or if it was around $2-3.
